events.name: Smith's Point Fish Fry
events.description: Visit Smith's Point every Wednesday night and you'll experience the most iconic event that happens on Grand Bahama Island.

events.name: McClean's Town Conch Cracking Festival
events.description: McClean's Town Conch Cracking is an annual festival which features all conch related dishes as well as competitions and live entertainment in McClean's Town.

events.name: Oktoberfest - Beer & BBQ
events.venue: Freetown Heritage Festival Site, East End
events.description: A new event on Grand Bahama Island. Oktoberfest features two local breweries: Commonwealth Brewery and Bahamian Brewery, live entertainment, Junkanoo rush-outs and all things BBQ.

events.name: Conchman Triathlon
events.description: This event consists of a 750M swim, 25K bike and 5K run that provides visitors and locals the opportunity to compete, build and maintain a healthy physical and mental state.

events.name: Tabernacle Thanksgiving Basketball Tournament
events.description: Tabernacle Baptist Academy's annual invitational basketball tournament features teams international teams as well as teams throughout The Bahamas.

events.name: Festival Noel
events.description: The Rand Nature Center's signature holiday festival, offers and evening with wine and art and features local artists. All funds raised go to The Bahamas National Trust for further development of national parks in The Bahamas.

events.name: Freetown Fire Hearth Food & Heritage Festival
events.description: Freetown Fire Hearth Festival is held every year on Whit Monday. It offers visitors and locals a unique cultural experience that showcases culinary skills, hospitality and the rich history of Grand Bahama's first black settlement.
